text: {"reply":"Thanks for the correction: the Tessera is the unit with the light. I can't check the recall or the warranty yet, because I need to verify you first. When you have the sheet, please send your last name and the plate or repair-order number (RO-######) for the Tessera. You don't need to send the VIN. Because the unit is registered to the company, a person may also need to confirm that you're authorised to ask about it. A person will review this request.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"A customer who gave a name and company asked whether an intermittent engine warning light on a company Meridian is a warranty matter and whether it relates to a recall notice. The customer first said Kestrel, then corrected it to Tessera. They gave no plate or RO number, so verification was not done and no tools were called. The vehicle is company-owned and the caller's authorisation is unconfirmed, so a person should check it. The customer will send the plate or RO number later.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P15","P14","P03"]}
